title: [RDTL] Parliamentary Laws No. 6/2002 — Alterations to Budget Appropriations for the Fiscal Year 2001-2002
text:
DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF TIMOR-LESTE
NATIONAL PARLIAMENT
Office of the Speaker
___________________________
Law No. 6/2002
ALTERATIONS TO THE APPROPRIATIONS
FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2001-2002
The purpose of this Law is to adjust the appropriations for the fiscal year 2001/2002, in the face
of a decrease in donor contributions by $6,846,000 of revenues for the Budget of Timor-Leste.
Under section 3(b), of Regulation No. 2000/1, section 23.1(a) and section 23.2(b), of Regulation
No. 2001/13, and with a view to modifying UNTAET Regulation No. 2001/31 on Appropriations
for the fiscal year 2001/2002 allocating expenditures for the proper operation of the Government;
Under the terms of section 92 and section 95.3(d) of the Constitution, the National Parliament
enacts the following that shall have the force of law:
Section 1
Alteration of appropriations
The amounts on the Schedule to Regulation No. 2001/31 (No. 2), on appropriations for the fiscal
year 2001/2002, shall be modified as per the Schedule to the present Law, which is an integral
part thereof.
Section 2
Provisional Provisions
The drafting of the present law is governed by the provisions contained in UNTAET Regulation
No. 2001/13 and is aimed at modifying and adjusting Regulation No. 2001/31 on appropriations
for the fiscal year 2001/2002.

Section 3
Entry into Force
1. 1. The present law shall enter into force on the day following its publication.
2. 2. Managerial acts relating to budgetary execution, undertaken as from 1 June 2002, in
accordance with the present law, are considered as having been endorsed.
Approved on 26 July 2002
The Speaker of the National Parliament
Francisco Guterres ‘Lú-Olo’
Promulgated on 20 August 2002
To be published.
The President of the Republic
José Alexandre Gusmão ‘Kay Rala Xanana Gusmão’
